summary: Admin Reporting Dashboard ('The Nightly Pulse') fully tested. All 12 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend UI elements verified. CSV export works correctly. Tab navigation between Management and Reporting works bidirectionally.

minor.issue: Returns 403 for super_admin role - inconsistent with /api/admin/reporting which allows both admin and super_admin. Not related to new reporting feature but causes console errors when super_admin views AdminPanel.

passed_tests: GET /api/admin/reporting returns 200 for authenticated admin/super_admin
GET /api/admin/reporting response structure has all required fields (summary, leaderboard, hourly_volume, waitlist, financial)
Summary object has cars_parked, cars_retrieved, active_inventory, avg_retrieval_mins, retrieval_status, total_tips, collection_rate
retrieval_status returns valid color code (green/amber/red based on avg retrieval time)
Leaderboard returns list of valets with parked/retrieved counts, avg speed, tips
hourly_volume returns 24 hours of intake/retrieval data for bar chart
waitlist returns list of overdue retrieval requests (or empty array if none)
financial returns pending_tips_count, paid_tips_total, platform_fees, payout array
GET /api/admin/reporting/export returns CSV file with correct headers
CSV filename format is swiftvalet_payout_YYYY-MM-DD.csv
Unauthorized users get 401/403 on reporting endpoints
Admin Reporting page (/admin/reporting) loads correctly
The Nightly Pulse title displays correctly
Tonight's Performance section shows all 4 stat cards (Parked, Retrieved, Active Inv, Retrieval Time)
Avg Retrieval Time shows color-coded indicator (tested RED > 12 min)
Financial snapshot shows placeholder data with 'Placeholder' label
Valet Leaderboard table displays valet names, parked count, retrieved count, avg speed, tips
Peak Hour Heatmap bar chart renders with intake (blue) and retrieval (purple) bars
Wait-List Alert section shows empty state ('No overdue requests')
Financial Reconciliation section shows pending tips, paid tips, platform fee, valet payout summary
Download Payout CSV button triggers file download with correct filename
Tab navigation from Management to Reporting works
Tab navigation from Reporting to Management works
Back button (arrow) navigates to Admin Management page
critical_code_review_comments: Minor inconsistency: /api/admin/tips only allows 'admin' role while /api/admin/reporting allows both 'admin' and 'super_admin'. Consider making this consistent.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing vehicles and valets from previous testing.
